title: XL750 Transalp (Custom Edition)
description: Representing Honda's prowess in the Adventure Tourer class, the Honda XL750 Transalp (Custom Edition) is delivers all-weather long-haul versatility with long-travel suspension compliance. A 750cc powerplant pumps out 89 HP and 73 Nm of torque, striking an optimal balance between fuel economy and spirited passing power. With a commanding 855mm perch delivering excellent ground clearance and expansive sightlines and a comfortable Aggressive Forward Tuck layout, it offers fatigue-free ergonomics whether carving traffic or cruising the open highway.
